channel.title: News Talk 980 CKNW - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from News Talk 980 CKNW (cknw.com)

item.title: Recipe: Plant-based breakfast, whipped tofu
item.description: This is an easy plant-based breakfast idea that can add some protein and flavour to your everyday breakfast! It's easy to make as well!

item.title: ‘At first I cried’: How Iranian Canadians are reacting to the U.S. strikes in Iran
item.description: Iranian Canadians gathered in various cities across the country this weekend celebrating recent strikes in Iran by the U.S. targeting 'imminent threats from the Iranian regime.'

item.title: At least 2 dead, 14 injured in Texas bar shooting
item.description: The FBI's Joint Terrorism Task Force is working with the Austin Police Department on the investigation, according to the agency's acting special agent in charge.

item.title: ‘Something just went off’: Canadians in Middle East describe ‘surreal’ Iran missile strikes
item.description: Canadians visiting and living in several Middle East countries are dealing with various emotions as Iran fires missiles in retaliation for the U.S. and Israel's bombardment.

item.title: Kitchener Rangers clinch Midwest Division title with victory over London Knights
item.description: Seb Gatto of the London Knights stopped 35 of 37 Kitchener Ranger shots in a game played on March 1 at the Kitchener Memorial Auditorium.

item.title: Ontario enters March with frigid cold snap as wind chills plummet
item.description: Snow is not likely in Toronto, and the extreme cold will likely be short lived, with above zero temperatures returning to many parts of the province by Tuesday.

item.title: As U.S. and Israel trade blows with Iran, what’s next?
item.description: While questions are being raised about whether a regime change is possible in Iran, experts say attacks by Iran on Israel are likely to continue in the days to come.

item.title: Calls grow for Tumbler Ridge public inquiry as 2 B.C. MPs say answers needed
item.description: Their call echoes an earlier appeal from B.C. Conservative Party MLA Larry Neufeld, who said that it is time for the province to establish a public inquiry under provincial law.

item.title: 2 women face abduction, assault charges after Amber Alert in Winnipeg
item.description: Winnipeg police say a two-year-old boy was found safe thanks to an Amber Alert Friday. A concerned citizen recognized the two suspects and took the child from them.

item.title: Photos: Hundreds gather at Optimist Hill for second annual Skijor YXE
item.description: Athletes of all ages were at Optimist Hill in Saskatoon Sunday for Skijor YXE. The sport features skiers and snowboarders being pulled by horses to perform jumps and tricks.
